span.p:
Read sensors:
TPS → A0 (0–100 %)
TPS rate → updateAccelPump()
FPS → A1 (1/16 bar units)
IAT → A2 (°C, NTC lookup)
ET → A3 (°C, NTC lookup)
BAT → A7 (1/16 V units)

disablePump()
PWM = 0, integral reset
pump_active = false

span.p:
Update LEDs:
Green — solid=idle, blink 5 Hz=pump running/priming
Red — blink 5 Hz while injector fired recently

span.p:
target = low_bar or high_bar
(based on rpm vs threshold)
error = target − fps_sixteenth_bar
output = (kp·error·1000 + ki·integral) / 16000
anti-windup: skip integral update if saturated
pump_pwm = clamp(output, 0, 255)
analogWrite D3 = pump_pwm

span.p:
calculatePulseWidth(rpm, tps, iat, et)
base = map[rpm][tps] × 100 µs
× IAT correction (Q8.8)
× ET correction (Q8.8)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
accel = getAccelPumpExtra()
pw = min(base + accel, 25000 µs)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fireInjector(pw)
D4 HIGH, schedule COMPA close

span.p:
Dispatch command:
0x01 READ_SENSORS → 14-byte sensor packet
0x02 WRITE_MAP → update + EEPROM
0x03 WRITE_PID → update + EEPROM
0x04 WRITE_PRESSURE → update + EEPROM
0x05 PUMP_PRIME → run pump 2 s
0x0B WRITE_AXIS → update + EEPROM
0x0D PUMP_SET → manual on/off
0x0E PUMP_MODE → PID / always-on
0x11/0x12 TPS_CAL → calibrate + EEPROM
0x15 WRITE_ACCEL_PUMP → update + EEPROM
… → ACK
